lessons.title: Make a brand promise you can inspect
lessons.ai_should: draft alternatives and flag missing evidence
lessons.human_should: choose the running project, justify its promise, and own its claims

lessons.title: An audience is a testable choice
lessons.ai_should: organize sources and propose research questions
lessons.human_should: choose the segment, conduct any real interaction, and interpret the evidence

lessons.title: Turn strategy into a useful constraint
lessons.human_should: select and defend the positioning and the tradeoffs it creates

lessons.title: Give the brand a coherent structure
lessons.ai_should: generate candidates and inspect structural consistency
lessons.human_should: select the architecture and names and identify unresolved rights or review needs

lessons.title: Build a repeatable visual system
lessons.ai_should: generate code and design alternatives within the brief
lessons.human_should: set creative direction, inspect the rendered work, and decide which system serves the audience

lessons.title: A brand voice must survive a factual check
lessons.ai_should: draft and vary copy while checking explicit constraints
lessons.human_should: choose the voice, verify promises, and edit for audience and context

lessons.title: Check the promise across the journey
lessons.ai_should: simulate paths and propose failure cases
lessons.human_should: inspect the experience, gather real feedback when available, and own service commitments

lessons.title: Make every channel carry the same claim
lessons.human_should: choose the campaign objective, approve actual claims, and authorize any real release

lessons.title: A number that moved needs an explanation
lessons.human_should: choose meaningful measures and judge what the evidence can support

lessons.title: Make brand rules usable at the decision point
lessons.ai_should: identify dependencies and draft consistent revisions
lessons.human_should: decide whether to refresh or rebrand and approve the tradeoff

lessons.title: Make the ethical claim earn its evidence
lessons.ai_should: locate candidate support and propose qualified wording
lessons.human_should: inspect the evidence, decide which claims are defensible, and own the commitments

lessons.title: Respond to what is known, not what sounds reassuring
lessons.ai_should: draft and compare statements against the fact record
lessons.human_should: judge the response, preserve uncertainty, and authorize real commitments

lessons.title: Adapt the message without inventing the audience
lessons.human_should: define the audience, seek appropriate feedback, and decide the limits of the adaptation

lessons.title: Turn the project into inspectable evidence
lessons.ai_should: organize and draft the case study from supplied evidence
lessons.human_should: curate the work, identify the actual contribution, and own the story

lessons.title: Ship a coherent brand someone else can use
lessons.ai_should: assemble, check, and challenge the candidate package
lessons.human_should: set final creative direction, verify the evidence, and own approvals and the handoff
